purpose: Issue-derived recorded reproduction and partial path-sorting repair; not a full multi-key solution or benchmark score.
coverage: Repeatable --sort path, global ordering beyond 1000 entries with a zero buffering deadline, and limiting after sorting on lowercase ASCII paths.
not_implemented: Other sort keys, reverse/grouping/natural/random modifiers, case-folded comparisons, and full task semantics.
regression_scope: Reproduction-only controller slice; no separate public regression suite or held-out verifier.
